data.name: Eunicea
data.gender_notes: Eunicea is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Eunice', meaning 'good victory'. In the New Testament, Eunice was a woman who converted to Christianity with her husband, Lydia, and was later baptized by the apostle Paul. The name Eunicea carries the meaning “Good victory” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Eunicea usually hope their child will grow to embody good victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the victory of faith and conversion.
data.etymology: Eunicea belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eunicea total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אוניקיאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוניקיאה הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'טובה וחסדה לאלוקים ולבני אדם'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'Εὐνίκη' (Eunike), שפירושה 'ניצחון טוב' או 'טובה מנצחת'. השם אוניקיאה מופיע בברית החדשה, בספר טימוטאוס, כהתייחסות לאם של טימוטאוס, שהייתה נוצרייה אדוקה.

in_greek.name: Εὐνικία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εὐνικία προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'Εὐ' (eu), που σημαίνει 'καλός' ή 'καλό', και 'νίκη' (nike), που σημαίνει 'νίκη'. Στη Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Eunike αναφέρεται στη μητέρα του Τιμόθεου, ενός μαθητή του Παύλου. Η Eunike ήταν μια πιστή Χριστιανή και το όνομά της αντανακλά την πνευματική της νίκη και την καλή της σχέση με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Eunicea
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eunicea derivatur ex Graecis vocibus 'Εὐ' (eu), quod significat 'bonum' seu 'bona', et 'νίκη' (nike), quod significat 'victoria'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Eunicea gerebatur a matre Timothei, discipuli Pauli. Nomen hoc reflectit victoriam spiritualem et bonam eius relationem cum Deo.

in_english.name: Eunicea
in_english.meaning: Good victory, noble triumph, or well-conquering
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eunicea originates from the Greek words 'Εὐ' (eu), meaning 'good' or 'well', and 'νίκη' (nike), meaning 'victory'. It is derived from the name Eunice, which appears in the New Testament as the mother of Timothy, a disciple of Paul. Eunice was a devoted Christian, and her name reflects her spiritual victory and noble character. The name Eunicea carries the connotations of goodness, triumph, and spiritual achievement, making it a meaningful choice for a Christian child.
